items: 【VERSATILE SUPPORT FOR CLIMBING PLANTS】 Measuring 24" (60cm) tall and 9.4" (23.8cm) wide, this set of 4 trellises provides excellent support for a variety of climbing plants. Perfectly designed for both planters and ground soil, they gently lift trailing vines, prevent drooping, and encourage healthy upward growth anywhere in your home or garden.

【RUSTPROOF & STURDY METAL】 Crafted from high-quality, solid iron with a premium black powder-coated finish. This weatherproof construction ensures excellent resistance to rust and corrosion, offering heavy-duty, long-lasting support for years of outdoor and indoor use without snapping or bending.

【EASY TO USE & GREAT VALUE】 No tools or complex assembly required! Simply push the sturdy legs deeply into the soil for instant, freestanding stability. This superb value 4-pack allows you to train multiple climbing plants across your patio, balcony, living room, or conservatory.

【ELEGANT FAN-SHAPED DESIGN】 Combining practical plant support with a decorative aesthetic. The elegant, widening fan structure not only keeps unruly stems tidy but also adds height and a beautiful architectural element to your landscaping, flower beds, or indoor plant displays.

【VERSATILE CLIMBING SUPPORT】 A must-have accessory for any plant lover. Highly versatile and ideal for supporting a wide variety of climbers, including trailing ivy, clematis, jasmine, monstera, roses, sweet peas, and even potted vegetable plants like cucumbers or cherry tomatoes.
